description: Browse purchasable products with prices in credits ($1 = 1 credit). DePIN supply-telemetry, provenance, derivation-replay, history and the intel bundle start at $0.49. Grade purchases are conditional on measured-grade availability; check /v1/credits/pricing before buying. Signal-feed tiers, DAG-manifold tiers and mcp_unlimited are priced but NOT yet purchasable: their entitlement is not wired into the serving API, so purchase_data refuses them with 503 not_yet_deliverable rather than charging you for nothing. Call after register_agent.
